design.colorMode: light by default with an explicit dark token fallback

motion.primary: scroll-linked cinematic video and GSAP product rail
motion.secondary: restrained reveals, pointer depth and active process states

must: Keep one clear H1 per page
Preserve useful legacy URLs with redirects

decisions: Use one continuous 18-second video scrubbed across six equal scroll beats.
Use a static 4K consultation fallback on mobile and reduced-motion devices.
Use 21st insurance components only as structural references because the production site is framework-free.
Make the primary conversion a prepared insurance-review email instead of a stored web form.
Use a full-width sticky navigation header in normal document flow so it never obstructs the cinematic story.
Use an Apple-inspired light visual system with translucent white navigation, system typography, quiet hairlines and restrained depth.
Use three distinct 4K editorial images for business insurance, employee benefits and personal insurance instead of reusing the cinematic hero assets.
Use a GSAP ScrollTrigger horizontal product story on desktop with native CSS scroll snap on touch devices and static reduced-motion behavior.
Move directly from the cinematic story into the product rail without an additional marketing-intro section.
Place company facts inside the About section and use a compact multi-column footer with services, company links, contact details and regulatory evidence.
Use a 68% translucent, lightly blurred glass material for product copy panels so each 4K scene remains visible behind the content.
